exact_route_choices.decided_by: the SWBPIPE Agent 0 decided the route (12 November 2026); the inputs below were recorded by the CAEPIPE interoperation Type 1
exact_route_choices.model_file_condition: the stored results of the target program are bound by hash to the model file written from the tracked document; a twin is a second SWBPIPE side of a stored result only if the writer, given the twin with the same piping code and reference temperature, writes the same model file bytes, with every differing line listed otherwise; a twin that fails this is not compared

other_inputs.anchor_movements: the same values, stated as boundary motion (absolute reference displacement) of the moved support in the case's analysis_state, the only form the exact route takes them in; the document then carries the load/reference-state group: one reference configuration of the authored geometry with a direct-strain basis and no fit, every pipe on its base properties with an unchanged-reference thermal state, every support an active model device, every stored load a source of factor 1
other_inputs.anything_else: set to the value that restates the tracked model; a requirement that cannot be met without a value that changes mechanics leaves the model refused, with the refusal's code, and that refusal is a finding
other_inputs.bend_modifiers: the record states bend modifiers that do not enter mechanics (stress intensification) as 1 where the exact route requires them. Done: none was added, because the exact route does not require one: it admits each bend with a warning (BEND_USER_MODIFIER_INPUT_MISSING, the same warning the pressure-free route gives) and does not refuse it; and a stated factor would add a record (BSIF) to the model file, which the model file condition does not allow
other_inputs.corrosion_allowance: 0 m on every pipe section (the exact contract requires it stated; the models are bare pipe)
other_inputs.material: constitutive_basis homogeneous_isotropic_E_nu_v1 with Poisson's ratio the value the tracked G was formed from (G = E/(2(1 + nu)) in this generator); the tracked shear_modulus is not restated, since the exact route takes G only from E and nu
other_inputs.mechanics: geometry, sections, E, G (as the Poisson's ratio it was formed from), expansion coefficient, loads, restraints, spring rates, imposed movements, bend radius, angle and flexibility factor are the tracked values unchanged
other_inputs.pressure_regions: an explicit empty list on every load case (no tranche 1 model has pressure)
other_inputs.thermal_change: the same temperature interval per pipe, as the tracked primitive thermal load, which the exact route takes as it is

exact_route_choices.recorded_before: These choices were recorded before any exact-route result for these models existed, and so before any exact-route result was compared with, or looked at beside, a value of the target program. The pressure-free route's results for all 60 models had already been seen, screened against the target program's results, before they were recorded; so the shear model rests on the public source below, and the other value of that one input is run as a declared series member.

shear_model.consequence: SWBPIPE's coefficient is its own energy-matched annulus factor kappa_E (DEL-05-03); shear_deformation stays a named inexact input on every case that names it, in the 5e-3 class; nothing is fitted and the shear coefficient is not a free parameter
not_settled_by_the_source: the value of the shape factor
whether the shear term applies to steel pipe as well as to fibre reinforced plastic pipe (DEL-17-01 question CQ-17-01-010, open)

series.name: exact-shear-model
series.note: euler_bernoulli is the declared second member, declared before any run and run once; it shows the size of the input and is not the side used for the screen

source.states: the stiffness matrix of a pipe is calculated with an axial term L/EA, a shear term (shape factor x L/GA), a bending term L/EI and a torsion term, and for an isotropic material G = E/2(1 + Poisson's ratio): the public description of the pipe element includes a transverse shear flexibility term
source.title: Fiber Reinforced Plastic Piping (FRP), section "Stiffness matrix" (the target program's public technical reference)

oppres_fields: pressure correction for bends: 0 off, 1 on
from version 13.00: Bourdon included in the expansion load cases (0) or the sustained load cases (1)
pressure_hypothesis.refuted_by: on the closed straights P1 and P2, the target program's change between the pressure-default and pressure-elongation-on runs differs, beyond the screening profile, from the closed forms' change: each anchor's axial reaction changing by (1 - 2 nu) p A_i (P1), or the free end's axial displacement changing by (1 - 2 nu) p A_i L/(E A_s) (P2); or its axial results there do not change at all
pressure_hypothesis.statement: HYPOTHESIS, which the pressure-elongation-on series tests and does not assume: the target program's Bourdon effect switch, with Bourdon in the sustained load cases, corresponds on straight pipe to SWBPIPE's pressure elongation, the closed-end free pressure strain (1 - 2 nu) p A_i/(E A_s), applied in case:sustained. Nothing about the target program is stated beyond the format facts of its OPPRES record.

pressure-bend-opening.description: the closed cantilever L of P7 in its pressure-default and pressure-elongation-on runs. Pressure elongation does not turn the free end of a closed cantilever (build_p7), so SWBPIPE's change of that rotation between the runs is 0 and the target program's change isolates the bend opening of its Bourdon switch. The same pair of an anchored L (P4) does not isolate it: between anchors the legs' elongation bends the L and turns its ends too
pressure-bend-opening.observed: case:sustained rotation about Y of the free end node:B
